hazelMcCallionLine.name: Hazel McCallion Line / Hurontario LRT
hazelMcCallionLine.stationSequenceCaveat: Names visually verified against Figure 44, printed page 99 / PDF page 107 of Metrolinx’s October 2025 PRESTO standard. Its diagram is schematic, not platform geometry. City Centre is a spur. Clip track geometry to the Mississauga boundary; northern Brampton stations remain outside the city model.
hazelMcCallionLine.geometryProvenance: OpenStreetMap live construction ways accessed 2026-09-20 via Overpass. The 50 LineString features include double tracks, depot sidings and Brampton extent; community mapping, not engineering survey. Clip to municipal boundary for city-only display.
